tests.name: Live Grafana stale provisioning diagnosis
tests.command: kubectl -n monitoring get deployment kube-prometheus-stack-grafana -o json; kubectl -n monitoring logs deployment/kube-prometheus-stack-grafana -c grafana-sc-dashboard; kubectl -n monitoring exec deployment/kube-prometheus-stack-grafana -c grafana-sc-dashboard -- find /tmp/dashboards
tests.reason: The live pod uses an emptyDir dashboard volume with k8s-sidecar 2.10.1 in WATCH/ALL mode; root-level retired JSON files coexist with the 11 curated files and Grafana reports duplicate UIDs plus restricted database access. This is the defect addressed by the follow-up values change.
